text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion didn't show up even though it was time for training,
so while I was searching around campus...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mumu... I can't overlook this news...!
It'll affect not just Ireland, but other countries too...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. Want to read too?
Political articles are always so intriguing...!
choice_data_list: It's already time for training, though...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Is it that time already?
I-I'm so sorry, I got completely carried away...
choice_data_list: Make sure you read this later.
Make sure you read this later, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I let my guard down.
I'll be more careful from now on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion seems genuinely apologetic.
I let her off with a light warning.
